_about: Replies as the adapters return them (sources: smartlead, explee, mailbox). Built from the reply notes of the example cards, plus three extras: a reply with no card, a reply from a second address with no note, and a bounce notice. "mailbox_messages" is mail in both directions, used by the one-rule check; the AI agent emails match the "sent" notes on the cards by recipient and time.

replies.subject: Re: dispatch for your HVAC crews
replies.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for reaching out. Our dispatchers run the day from a shared Google Sheet and a whiteboard, and the techs in the trucks call in all day to ask what is next. Overtime got out of hand this winter. Does this sync with QuickBooks? We are on QuickBooks Online.

Marcus

replies.subject: Re: dispatch for your plumbing crews
replies.body:
Hi Sam,

What does it cost? We have 18 trucks and two people in the office doing dispatch, and I need a number before I look at anything else.

Tom

replies.subject: Re: dispatch for electrical crews
replies.body:
Hi Sam,

We dispatch 65 electricians across the GTA from Google Calendar and it is a mess. Do you have anything for electrical contractors? And how does the QuickBooks part work?

Grace

replies.subject: Re: Your Northstar Dispatch trial
replies.body:
Hi Dana,

We run about 120 technicians out of Phoenix and Tucson. The first thing to fix is reassigning jobs when a tech runs over, because our dispatchers do it by phone and overtime is the result. We are on QuickBooks Online. I decide this together with our COO, Mark Pierce.

Rosa

replies.subject: Re: dispatch for your crews

Pete
